mapper.insert: INSERT INTO todo (user_id, title, description, priority, due_date, tags, status, source_type, source_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{priority}, #{dueDate}, #{tags}, #{status}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM todo WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND status='pending'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schedule_event (user_id, title, description, event_type, start_time, end_time, all_day, recurrence, color) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{eventType}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{allDay}, #{recurrence}, #{color})
